name: koch-codes-profile-agent
description: Answers questions about Christopher Koch’s professional profile, research publications and published apps using the site’s public content. Read-only and stateless.

skills.name: Profile questions
skills.description: Answer questions about experience, skills, awards and certifications from the published profile.
examples: Which cloud platforms has he worked with?

skills.name: Publications
skills.description: List and summarise published research with arXiv ids, dates and authors.
examples: List his papers on AI governance.

skills.name: Apps
skills.description: Describe published iOS, iPadOS and macOS apps with App Store links and privacy position.
examples: Which iOS apps did he release?
